questions: When a bill doesn't split evenly, which people get the extra pesewa: the first names on the list, the person who paid, or chosen at random?
Can someone fix or delete a recorded expense or payment later, and if so, who is allowed to do that?
Who can record things in the app: any group member, only the person who created the group, or only the people involved in each expense or payment?
answers: Any of them, as long as the shares differ by at most one pesewa and add up to the bill.
